domain: Finite bounded reference conversions, exact signed existing/missing IDs and defined late matching failure only. No first-reference matching failure, nonfinite/overflow conversion, allocation failure, malformed material selectors, invalid connectivity or special command keywords. Count inputs are on selector line because skipblank=0. Allocation capacity is observed independently of logical count; zero/negative retained contents are not inferred from count.
probe_notes: Only successful reference scalar scans expose numeric output; failed scans never read potentially uninitialized local destination.
Reference calloc is accepted only at exact return RVA3883ee with width4 and bounded capacity. Tracked free operations record pre-free bytes only.
Full primary/linked material snapshots plus allocation-aware mesh descriptors preserve feature49/50 refresh evidence; no extra application calls are injected.
Finalizer lookup-before snapshots and stage endpoints expose sequential immediate mutations; no graph reachability interpretation is assumed.
